appointments.availability: Available round-the-clock at the emergency triage desk and ambulance bay.
appointments.appointment_instructions: Report directly to emergency triage and share any prior treatment summary if available.
appointments.cancellation_policy: Emergency triage appointments cannot be cancelled once registration has begun.

appointments.availability: Routine OPD slots are confirmed after registration and token issuance.
appointments.appointment_instructions: Arrive 15 minutes early and bring a list of current medicines and symptoms.
appointments.cancellation_policy: Appointments may be cancelled up to 24 hours before the scheduled time.

appointments.availability: Cardiology consultation slots are released in the morning and after lunch sessions.
appointments.appointment_instructions: Carry previous ECG or echo reports and avoid caffeine before the visit if tests are planned.
appointments.cancellation_policy: Appointments may be cancelled up to 24 hours before the scheduled time.

appointments.availability: Neurology slots follow the regular OPD schedule and are assigned after token generation.
appointments.appointment_instructions: Bring a written list of headache or seizure episodes and any prior scan reports.
appointments.cancellation_policy: Appointments may be cancelled up to 24 hours before the scheduled time.

appointments.availability: Orthopedic review appointments are offered during the standard outpatient window.
appointments.appointment_instructions: Carry fracture films, discharge notes, and any physiotherapy advice already given.
appointments.cancellation_policy: Appointments may be cancelled up to 24 hours before the scheduled time.

appointments.availability: Pediatric consultation slots are reserved for child visits and immunization follow-up.
appointments.appointment_instructions: Bring the child's growth chart, vaccination card, and a guardian for registration.
appointments.cancellation_policy: Appointments may be cancelled up to 24 hours before the scheduled time.

appointments.availability: Women health appointments are scheduled in dedicated antenatal and outpatient slots.
appointments.appointment_instructions: Carry antenatal notes, scan reports, and any medication list currently being used.
appointments.cancellation_policy: Appointments may be cancelled up to 24 hours before the scheduled time.

appointments.availability: Dermatology slots are assigned for acne, rash, and procedure review visits.
appointments.appointment_instructions: Avoid applying makeup or topical creams on the affected skin before examination.
appointments.cancellation_policy: Appointments may be cancelled up to 24 hours before the scheduled time.

appointments.availability: ENT outpatient appointments are scheduled across the standard clinic timings.
appointments.appointment_instructions: Bring previous hearing or sinus reports and avoid using ear drops before review unless prescribed.
appointments.cancellation_policy: Appointments may be cancelled up to 24 hours before the scheduled time.

appointments.availability: Vision clinic appointments run during regular eye department hours.
appointments.appointment_instructions: Carry your current spectacles or contact lens details and any prior eye test reports.
appointments.cancellation_policy: Appointments may be cancelled up to 24 hours before the scheduled time.

appointments.availability: Respiratory clinic appointments are scheduled for outpatient pulmonary review.
appointments.appointment_instructions: Carry previous chest X-rays or lung function reports and avoid smoking before the visit.
appointments.cancellation_policy: Appointments may be cancelled up to 24 hours before the scheduled time.

appointments.availability: Kidney clinic appointments are offered during the standard nephrology OPD schedule.
appointments.appointment_instructions: Bring recent creatinine or urine reports and note your current fluid intake if dialysis is being considered.
appointments.cancellation_policy: Appointments may be cancelled up to 24 hours before the scheduled time.

appointments.availability: Digestive clinic slots are released for abdominal pain and endoscopy evaluation visits.
appointments.appointment_instructions: Carry any endoscopy, ultrasound, or liver function reports related to your digestive symptoms.
appointments.cancellation_policy: Appointments may be cancelled up to 24 hours before the scheduled time.

appointments.availability: Endocrine appointments are scheduled for diabetes, thyroid, and hormonal review.
appointments.appointment_instructions: Bring blood sugar logs and any thyroid or hormone test reports from the last visit.
appointments.cancellation_policy: Appointments may be cancelled up to 24 hours before the scheduled time.

appointments.availability: Mental health consultations are scheduled in private outpatient rooms during clinic hours.
appointments.appointment_instructions: Carry any previous therapy notes and arrive a little early for confidential registration.
appointments.cancellation_policy: Appointments may be cancelled up to 24 hours before the scheduled time.

appointments.availability: Oncology appointments are scheduled with a coordinated registration and review process.
appointments.appointment_instructions: Bring biopsy reports, imaging records, and a current medicine list for treatment planning.
appointments.cancellation_policy: Appointments may be cancelled up to 24 hours before the scheduled time.

appointments.availability: Urology consultations are assigned during the standard outpatient hours.
appointments.appointment_instructions: Carry urine or ultrasound reports and drink water only if instructed for a procedure.
appointments.cancellation_policy: Appointments may be cancelled up to 24 hours before the scheduled time.

appointments.availability: Dental appointments are scheduled for routine oral evaluation and procedure planning.
appointments.appointment_instructions: Carry prior dental records and avoid eating immediately before a procedure if local anesthesia is planned.
appointments.cancellation_policy: Appointments may be cancelled up to 24 hours before the scheduled time.

appointments.availability: Rehabilitation slots are assigned for movement assessment and therapy planning.
appointments.appointment_instructions: Wear comfortable clothes and bring any brace, walker, or discharge summary related to the condition.
appointments.cancellation_policy: Appointments may be cancelled up to 24 hours before the scheduled time.

appointments.availability: Imaging slots are allocated based on scanner availability and patient preparation status.
appointments.appointment_instructions: Bring the imaging request form and confirm whether fasting or contrast preparation is required.
appointments.cancellation_policy: Imaging appointments may be cancelled up to 12 hours before the scheduled time.

appointments.availability: Sample review and collection slots are available throughout the laboratory service window.
appointments.appointment_instructions: Bring the laboratory request form and follow the fasting or collection instructions given at booking.
appointments.cancellation_policy: Laboratory appointments may be cancelled up to 12 hours before the scheduled time.

appointments.availability: Blood donation and compatibility checks are handled at the blood bank counter.
appointments.appointment_instructions: Eat a light meal, hydrate well, and disclose any recent illness or medication before donation.
appointments.cancellation_policy: Donor appointments may be cancelled up to 6 hours before the scheduled time.

appointments.availability: Medication counseling is provided at the dispensing counter during pharmacy operating hours.
appointments.appointment_instructions: Carry the original prescription and ask for dosage clarification before leaving the counter.
appointments.cancellation_policy: Counseling slots may be cancelled up to 4 hours before the scheduled time.

appointments.availability: Critical care family updates are available at all hours through the ICU desk.
appointments.appointment_instructions: Report to the ICU reception and carry the patient's treatment file or referral details.
appointments.cancellation_policy: ICU review requests cannot be cancelled once the patient is admitted under critical care.

appointments.availability: Neonatal care updates are coordinated through the NICU reception at all hours.
appointments.appointment_instructions: Use the NICU reception desk for all updates and bring any discharge or birth documentation.
appointments.cancellation_policy: NICU updates are handled under clinical priority and cannot be cancelled once scheduled.

appointments.availability: Dialysis sessions are assigned in fixed shifts based on machine availability.
appointments.appointment_instructions: Carry the dialysis card, recent lab values, and arrive early for weight and access checks.
appointments.cancellation_policy: Dialysis sessions may be cancelled up to 12 hours before the scheduled time.

appointments.availability: Rehabilitation therapy planning is scheduled to align with the patient's functional assessment.
appointments.appointment_instructions: Wear loose clothing and bring any mobility aids used during daily activities.
appointments.cancellation_policy: Therapy planning appointments may be cancelled up to 24 hours before the scheduled time.

appointments.availability: Vaccination slots are assigned for children, adults, and travel immunization visits.
appointments.appointment_instructions: Carry the immunization card and report any prior vaccine reaction before the dose is given.
appointments.cancellation_policy: Vaccination appointments may be cancelled up to 12 hours before the scheduled time.

appointments.availability: Health check-up packages are scheduled in dedicated preventive care slots.
appointments.appointment_instructions: Follow fasting instructions if the package includes blood work and carry any prior screening reports.
appointments.cancellation_policy: Health check-up appointments may be cancelled up to 24 hours before the scheduled time.

appointments.availability: Patient support and records assistance are available at the administration counter.

appointments.availability: Follow-up slots are reserved for prior cardiology patients who need treatment review.

appointments.cancellation_policy: Follow-up appointments may be cancelled up to 24 hours before the scheduled time.

appointments.availability: Second opinion consultations are scheduled after specialist case review and prior report submission.
appointments.appointment_instructions: Carry prior scan films, discharge summaries, and the first specialist opinion for comparison.
appointments.cancellation_policy: Second opinion appointments may be cancelled up to 24 hours before the scheduled time.

appointments.availability: Chronic disease review slots are kept for hypertension, diabetes, and long-term medication follow-up.
appointments.appointment_instructions: Bring home readings, recent labs, and a medicine list so the treatment plan can be adjusted safely.
appointments.cancellation_policy: Chronic disease review appointments may be cancelled up to 24 hours before the scheduled time.

appointments.availability: Super specialist oncology slots are assigned after report triage and referral review.
appointments.appointment_instructions: Carry pathology slides, imaging reports, and prior treatment summaries for multidisciplinary planning.
appointments.cancellation_policy: Super specialist appointments may be cancelled up to 24 hours before the scheduled time.

appointments.availability: Post-surgery review slots are reserved for wound check and mobility assessment visits.
appointments.appointment_instructions: Carry operation notes, wound care instructions, and any physiotherapy plan already issued.
appointments.cancellation_policy: Post-surgery follow-up appointments may be cancelled up to 24 hours before the scheduled time.

appointments.availability: Child growth and vaccination review appointments are booked in the pediatric follow-up queue.
appointments.appointment_instructions: Bring the growth chart and vaccination card so the pediatrician can update the schedule.
appointments.cancellation_policy: Pediatric review appointments may be cancelled up to 24 hours before the scheduled time.

appointments.availability: Pre-pregnancy counseling is scheduled in dedicated women health counseling slots.
appointments.appointment_instructions: Bring previous gynecology reports and details of any ongoing medicines or supplements.
appointments.cancellation_policy: Counseling appointments may be cancelled up to 24 hours before the scheduled time.

appointments.availability: Cosmetic dermatology reviews are planned for procedure counselling and skin assessment.
appointments.appointment_instructions: Avoid applying active skincare products on the day of review unless instructed otherwise.
appointments.cancellation_policy: Cosmetic consultation appointments may be cancelled up to 24 hours before the scheduled time.

appointments.availability: Voice and hearing review appointments are reserved for targeted ENT evaluation.
appointments.appointment_instructions: Bring hearing test reports and avoid ear cleaning immediately before the appointment.
appointments.cancellation_policy: ENT review appointments may be cancelled up to 24 hours before the scheduled time.

appointments.availability: Cataract planning appointments are assigned before surgery scheduling and biometry.
appointments.appointment_instructions: Carry your current eyeglass prescription and arrive prepared for dilation if requested.
appointments.cancellation_policy: Pre-surgery eye appointments may be cancelled up to 24 hours before the scheduled time.

appointments.availability: Asthma follow-up slots are scheduled to review inhaler technique and symptom control.
appointments.appointment_instructions: Bring inhalers or a written medicine list so the physician can check technique and control.
appointments.cancellation_policy: Asthma follow-up appointments may be cancelled up to 24 hours before the scheduled time.

appointments.availability: Chronic kidney disease review appointments are arranged for lab follow-up and medication assessment.
appointments.appointment_instructions: Bring recent creatinine, urine, and blood pressure readings for review.
appointments.cancellation_policy: CKD review appointments may be cancelled up to 24 hours before the scheduled time.

appointments.availability: Pre-endoscopy consultations are scheduled before the procedure slot is confirmed.
appointments.appointment_instructions: Follow fasting guidance and bring all digestive system reports before the procedure is booked.
appointments.cancellation_policy: Pre-endoscopy appointments may be cancelled up to 24 hours before the scheduled time.

appointments.availability: Executive screening slots combine diabetes review with preventive endocrine assessment.
appointments.appointment_instructions: Arrive fasting if blood investigations are included in the package.
appointments.cancellation_policy: Executive health package appointments may be cancelled up to 24 hours before the scheduled time.

appointments.availability: Second opinion mental health consultations are scheduled after record review and confidentiality check-in.
appointments.appointment_instructions: Carry previous therapy notes and the current medicine list so the plan can be reassessed carefully.
appointments.cancellation_policy: Second opinion psychiatry appointments may be cancelled up to 24 hours before the scheduled time.

appointments.availability: MRI slots are allocated after safety screening and scanner confirmation.
appointments.appointment_instructions: Remove all metallic items and disclose any implants, pacemakers, or claustrophobia before scanning.
appointments.cancellation_policy: MRI appointments may be cancelled up to 12 hours before the scheduled time.

appointments.availability: CT slots are released after contrast screening and preparation checks.
appointments.appointment_instructions: Inform the technologist about allergies, kidney problems, or prior contrast reactions before the scan.
appointments.cancellation_policy: CT appointments may be cancelled up to 12 hours before the scheduled time.

appointments.availability: Ultrasound appointments are arranged according to fasting or bladder preparation requirements.
appointments.appointment_instructions: Follow the fasting instructions or arrive with a full bladder if that is specified in the request form.
appointments.cancellation_policy: Ultrasound appointments may be cancelled up to 12 hours before the scheduled time.

appointments.availability: X-ray slots are available throughout the day for routine and urgent imaging.
appointments.appointment_instructions: Remove jewellery and metal objects from the chest area before imaging.
appointments.cancellation_policy: X-ray appointments may be cancelled up to 6 hours before the scheduled time.

appointments.availability: ECG slots are assigned continuously during cardiology diagnostics hours.
appointments.appointment_instructions: Avoid applying oily lotions on the chest before the electrodes are placed.
appointments.cancellation_policy: ECG appointments may be cancelled up to 6 hours before the scheduled time.

appointments.availability: Echo screening is arranged after cardiology review and machine availability confirmation.
appointments.appointment_instructions: Wear clothing that allows chest access and bring previous cardiac imaging if available.
appointments.cancellation_policy: Echo appointments may be cancelled up to 12 hours before the scheduled time.

appointments.availability: Stress test slots are opened only after a physician reviews exercise suitability.
appointments.appointment_instructions: Wear comfortable sports shoes and avoid heavy meals before the test as instructed.
appointments.cancellation_policy: Stress test appointments may be cancelled up to 12 hours before the scheduled time.

appointments.availability: Blood collection is processed through timed lab slots to reduce queue congestion.
appointments.appointment_instructions: Follow fasting instructions exactly and bring the lab requisition slip with you.
appointments.cancellation_policy: Blood collection appointments may be cancelled up to 4 hours before the scheduled time.

appointments.availability: Endoscopy slots are fixed after pre-procedure clearance and fasting verification.
appointments.appointment_instructions: Fast as instructed and arrange an escort if sedation is planned for the procedure.

appointments.availability: Colonoscopy slots are confirmed only after bowel preparation instructions are completed.
appointments.appointment_instructions: Complete the bowel cleansing regimen exactly as instructed and bring a companion if sedation is planned.
appointments.cancellation_policy: Colonoscopy appointments may be cancelled up to 24 hours before the scheduled time.

appointments.availability: PFT slots are reserved for lung function testing and technician-assisted review.

appointments.availability: Dialysis session bookings are coordinated in fixed treatment shifts across the week.

appointments.availability: Biochemistry samples are collected through the lab appointment queue after preparation confirmation.
appointments.appointment_instructions: Follow fasting instructions if required and carry the lab form for sample labeling.
appointments.cancellation_policy: Biochemistry appointments may be cancelled up to 6 hours before the scheduled time.

appointments.availability: Pathology reviews are scheduled after specimen processing and pathologist sign-out.
appointments.appointment_instructions: Bring the biopsy request and any previous histopathology report for comparison.
appointments.cancellation_policy: Pathology review appointments may be cancelled up to 12 hours before the scheduled time.

appointments.availability: Biopsy processing slots are arranged after specimen submission and handling verification.
appointments.appointment_instructions: Use the approved specimen container and hand over the referral slip at sample reception.
appointments.cancellation_policy: Biopsy processing appointments may be cancelled up to 12 hours before the scheduled time.

appointments.availability: Emergency chest pain consultations are available immediately at the emergency triage desk.
appointments.appointment_instructions: Proceed to the emergency desk immediately and mention the onset time of chest pain.
appointments.cancellation_policy: Emergency appointments are not cancellable after triage has started.

appointments.availability: Trauma triage runs continuously for injuries requiring immediate stabilization.
appointments.appointment_instructions: Report with the injury time, visible wound status, and any first aid already given.
appointments.cancellation_policy: Trauma triage cannot be cancelled once the patient is being assessed.

appointments.availability: Stroke alert reviews are handled immediately in coordination with the emergency unit.
appointments.appointment_instructions: Bring the patient to the stroke alert area immediately and note the time symptoms began.
appointments.cancellation_policy: Stroke alert appointments cannot be cancelled once activation has started.

appointments.availability: Heart attack triage is available immediately and is prioritized over routine cardiac visits.
appointments.appointment_instructions: Proceed directly to the emergency cardiac bay and inform staff of any chest pressure or sweating.
appointments.cancellation_policy: Heart attack triage cannot be cancelled once the patient reaches the emergency cardiac bay.

appointments.availability: Critical care escalation is coordinated continuously with ICU and emergency staff.
appointments.appointment_instructions: Report to the ICU reception with the current treatment summary and ask for escalation review.
appointments.cancellation_policy: Critical care escalation requests are not cancelled once the patient has been accepted for review.

appointments.availability: ICU admission reviews are processed 24 hours a day through the critical care desk.
appointments.appointment_instructions: Carry all treatment papers and respond only through the ICU reception during admission review.
appointments.cancellation_policy: ICU admission reviews cannot be cancelled once bed allocation has begun.

appointments.availability: Emergency surgery triage is immediately available for patients needing operative stabilization.
appointments.appointment_instructions: Proceed directly to emergency triage and provide consent details if surgery is being considered.
appointments.cancellation_policy: Emergency surgery triage cannot be cancelled once operative evaluation has started.

appointments.availability: Emergency pediatric care is available at all hours for acutely unwell children.
appointments.appointment_instructions: Bring the child immediately to the emergency pediatric desk and mention fever, breathing trouble, or dehydration signs.
appointments.cancellation_policy: Emergency pediatric consultations cannot be cancelled once triage starts.

appointments.availability: Emergency obstetric review is available around the clock for pregnancy-related red flags.
appointments.appointment_instructions: Proceed directly to the emergency obstetrics desk and bring the antenatal record if available.
appointments.cancellation_policy: Emergency obstetrics consultations cannot be cancelled once triage is underway.

appointments.availability: Ambulance arrivals are triaged immediately on arrival through the emergency entrance.
appointments.appointment_instructions: Use the ambulance entrance and hand over the transfer note to the emergency registration staff.
appointments.cancellation_policy: Ambulance triage cannot be cancelled once the patient reaches the emergency entrance.
